method.target_cells: Batch cells whose ecoprovince intersects AB/ON/NS/NU/MB and whose coverage_class is no_data or distribution_borrowed is true.
method.donor_score: 0.30 same ecozone + 0.20 distance decay (800 km) + 0.25 exact direct fit / 0.15 exact pooled / 0.05 species-group proxy + 0.15 log10 site support + 0.05 group match + 0.05 donor SCANFI area.
method.confidence: high >= 0.75 with exact direct fit and >= 20 sites; medium >= 0.55; otherwise low.
method.no_plot_ecodistricts: Ecodistricts with zero sites in every coverage row. Donor ecodistricts are ranked by same ecoprovince, same ecozone, distance (500 km), site support, and species richness.

caveats: MGM curves are not joined; all rows carry mgm_join_pending=true.
Batch cells are ecoprovince-level and can span multiple provinces; target_provinces lists the overlap.
Donor support is measured by plot counts, not by ecological representativeness or variance compatibility.
SCANFI resolves ten species/classes; unmapped RSYC species cannot receive SCANFI area.
